root_cause: An earlier fix (bug 1999464) special-cased NukeCrossCompartmentWrappers() to leave CCWs pointing at DebuggerInstanceObject un-nuked, but the matching AllowNewWrapper() gate (which blocks creation of new CCWs into compartments/realms already marked as nuked) was not given the same exception. This mismatch between 'existing wrapper survives' and 'new wrapper creation is still blocked' violates invariants assumed by Compartment::wrap(), leading to corrupted/incoherent wrapper state and eventually use-after-free.
findings: NukeCrossCompartmentWrappers() was changed so that it skips nuking existing cross-compartment wrappers (CCWs) that point at a Debugger instance object (used to link Breakpoints back to their owning Debugger across realms). However, the companion function js::AllowNewWrapper(), which governs whether a *new* CCW may be created into a compartment/realm that has already had NukeCrossCompartmentWrapper
